Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: A user rating and written review about Looma persisted in Cloud Firestore.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who submitted the feedback.

authorName.description: Public display name shown on the review card (never an email address).

category.description: Area of Looma the feedback is about.

comment.description: Written feedback message from the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the feedback was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the feedback was last updated.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted admin marker document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Permanent community star ratings and user feedback for Looma.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Admin role documents for Looma moderation and owner replies.
